content:
令 \(Z_i=\frac{X_i}{2}\sim N(0,1)\)，则

\[
X_1^2+\cdots+X_4^2=4\sum_{i=1}^4 Z_i^2,\qquad X_5^2=4Z_5^2
\]

因此

\[
P\left(X_1^2+\cdots+X_4^2\le kX_5^2\right)
=P\left(\frac{\sum_{i=1}^4 Z_i^2}{Z_5^2}\le k\right)
\]

设 \(U=\sum_{i=1}^4 Z_i^2\sim \chi^2(4)\)，\(V=Z_5^2\sim \chi^2(1)\)，则

\[
F=\frac{U/4}{V/1}\sim F(4,1)
\]

且

\[
\frac{U}{V}=4F
\]

所以

\[
P\left(4F\le k\right)=P\left(F\le \frac{k}{4}\right)=\alpha
\]

按常见记号，\(F_\beta(4,1)\) 表示 \(F(4,1)\) 的上 \(\beta\) 分位数，即

\[
P(F>F_\beta(4,1))=\beta
\]

因此

\[
P\left(F\le F_{1-\alpha}(4,1)\right)=\alpha
\]

于是

\[
\frac{k}{4}=F_{1-\alpha}(4,1)
\]

\[
k=4F_{1-\alpha}(4,1)
\]

答案：D
